svg.text: What happens when a user asks a question
Manufacturing Intelligence - React -> Django API (streamed) -> LangGraph steps -> MySQL / Qdrant / Groq -> back to React, live
React Ask page (/ask) - a new chat, or a follow-up in an open chat
signed in? CSRF token? 1 to 1,000 characters? Reply: a stream of lines
The stream back to the page (NDJSON)
a step starts -> shown live ("Search the PDFs" ...)
a piece of the answer -> shown word by word
the last 3 questions of THIS chat - MySQL History (mi_app)
only, no AI call, 0 tokens. status: memory
saved preferences, used in all chats, e.g. "I only work with export sales"
Qdrant mi_pdfs, top 3 pieces - embeddings only, no tokens
from step 5, with the file name, title and page
only from the pieces, with the page; sent word by word
no - straight to data, no AI call
Qdrant mi_docs - top 5 rules / tables / examples
sql_chain + the user's memories; a chart question
that got NO_SQL is asked once more
one SELECT, allowed tables, max 500 rows, date checks
a line chart with only 1 row:
asked once more for one row per period;
still 1 row -> keep the first answer
a name in the question that matches nothing?
answer_chain, plain words; both: + the PDF pieces =
one answer; sent word by word
from the PDF pieces + one line
question, SQL, answer, status, tokens, time per step, sources - MySQL mi_app. A
15. The API sends "done" with the answer card
the last line of the stream - never the admin-only error details
a "Remember" message: memory added. Later on the page: Excel
download, chat renamed / removed (soft delete) / restored, question
The question itself is the History row.
live steps while it runs, the answer word by word, then: label, answer, 📄 sources,
17. React draws a chart from the rows
ECharts: line, bar, donut and more, with a 3D feel, 0 tokens; Chart / Table switch;
PNG; 1 row: "no chart can be drawn"
Always: backup AI model at the daily limit · wait and retry at the per-minute limit · a friendly message if the AI, MySQL or Qdrant is down
The SQL guard and the read-only login can never be skipped - not by the AI, a memory or the question.
